meaning: The image of Christ as the treasure held in earthen vessels.
quote: This very image of Christ is the treasure in the earthen vessels.

meaning: Typifies divinity, the divine nature wrought into and upon humanity.
quote: the gold overlaying the boards signifies divinity, the divine nature.

meaning: The worldly starting place, corresponding to the outer court, before the Passover deliverance.
quote: Are we in Egypt? in the wilderness? or in Canaan? … Are we in the worldly atmosphere

meaning: Typifies Christ within us, the well of living water that must be dug.
quote: While the rock is Christ on the cross, the well is Christ within us (John 4:14).

meaning: The court linen’s testimony: inside the church’s line, everything is purged and white.
quote: Outside this line everything is black, but within this line everything is white.

meaning: The lampstand typifies Christ as the light of life, shining within.
quote: The candlestick, or the lampstand, typifies Christ as the light of life.

meaning: The smitten rock typifies Christ on the cross, struck so living water may flow.
quote: The rock typifies Christ on the cross, smitten by God so that the living water … may flow out

meaning: The tabernacle color that “means heavenly.”
quote: Blue means heavenly, purple means royalty, and scarlet stands for redemption.

meaning: The color of the rams’ skins: the shedding of blood in redemption.
quote: The color red means the shedding of blood in Christ’s redemptive work.

meaning: Typifies redemption, the joining and covering of God’s building.
quote: Silver typifies redemption.

meaning: Typifies the flesh, which must be riven to enter the Holiest.
quote: the veil, which typifies the flesh (Heb. 10:20), must be riven and broken.

meaning: The church as God’s building, formed by experiencing Christ as life.
quote: the only way for the Church to be built up among us is to experience Christ in the spirit.

meaning: Symbolizes the humanity of Christ: fine, strong, without crudeness.
quote: the fine linen, which symbolizes the humanity of Christ with all His fine characteristics

meaning: The land of rest, a type of the all-inclusive Christ in our spirit.
quote: Christ is the good land of Canaan, and He is our rest.

meaning: The inmost sanctuary; today, the human spirit, God’s residence.
quote: Our human spirit is the Holiest of all which is God’s residence.

meaning: Typifies the second aspect of the cross, dealing with the self in the soul.
quote: these two waters typify the two aspects of the cross of Christ.

meaning: Typifies the first aspect of Christ’s death: worldly things buried.
quote: The water of the Red Sea typifies the first aspect of the effectiveness of Christ’s death.

meaning: In the outer court, typifies the cross of Christ / His all-inclusive death.
quote: In the outer court there is the altar, which typifies the cross of Christ

meaning: The type of Christ Himself, hidden in the Holiest of all.
quote: The Holiest of all contains one thing, the ark, the type of Christ Himself.

meaning: The outer covering: Christ humble and unappealing outwardly, strong against assault.
quote: He looks just like the strong badgers’ skin, unappealing in its outward appearance.

meaning: Believers as building material: humanity overlaid with divinity.
quote: the wood of the boards signifies humanity, the human nature

meaning: A type of Christ on the cross, made sin for us (John 3:14).
quote: He was typified by the brass serpent hanging upon the pole in the wilderness.

meaning: The rod in the ark typifies Christ’s inner resurrection power and authority.
quote: the hidden rod with sprouted buds, which is the inner resurrection power and authority.

meaning: Typify God’s glory embroidered into the humanity of Christ.
quote: The cherubim typify God’s glory

meaning: Christ himself as the church’s roof and outward expression.
quote: Only Christ must be expressed as the roof to cover us.

meaning: God’s building, the church, and the human spirit as His residence.
quote: This is the right way for us to be built up together as the dwelling place of God.

meaning: The human vessel that holds the treasure: the image of Christ.
quote: This very image of Christ is the treasure in the earthen vessels.

meaning: Christ’s redemption is the basis of God’s house (the silver sockets).
quote: Christ’s redemption is the basis and foundation for the building of God’s house.

meaning: Typifies Christ made sin for us; goats are figures of sinful people.
quote: the layer of curtains made of goats’ hair typifies Christ, who was made sin for us.

meaning: Corresponds to the soul, and to Israel’s wilderness wandering.
quote: the holy place represents the wilderness on one hand and the soul on the other.

meaning: The church: the place where God dwells, lives, and works out His life.
quote: The house of God is the place where God dwells, where He lives.

meaning: Typifies the resurrection savor of Christ.
quote: the incense altar typifies the resurrection savor of Christ.

meaning: Typifies Christ as the light of life.
quote: The candlestick, or the lampstand, typifies Christ as the light of life.

meaning: Typifies the cleansing work of the Holy Spirit.
quote: the laver, which typifies the cleansing work of the Holy Spirit.

meaning: The Spirit of life flowing from the smitten Christ and springing up within.
quote: the living water, which is the Spirit of life, may flow out into us.

meaning: Christ as daily life supply; the hidden manna is inner life supply.
quote: the hidden manna, which is the inner life and inner life supply

meaning: Corresponds to the body; the place of the altar and the laver.
quote: our body corresponds to the outer court, our soul to the holy place

meaning: The church as “the pillar and ground of the truth.”
quote: the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

meaning: The tabernacle color that “means royalty.”
quote: Blue means heavenly, purple means royalty, and scarlet stands for redemption.

meaning: The red-dyed skins signify that Christ bore our sins and shed His blood.
quote: the third layer signifies that He bore our sins and shed His blood to redeem us.

meaning: The tabernacle color that “stands for redemption.”
quote: Blue means heavenly, purple means royalty, and scarlet stands for redemption.

meaning: Christ as daily food and life supply.
quote: The showbread table reveals Christ as our daily life supply—He is our very bread of life.

meaning: Type of Christ and of Christians; God’s dwelling built in humanity.
quote: the tabernacle, or the temple, is not only the type of Christ, but also of Christians.

meaning: Fulfilled in us: body, soul, and spirit correspond to its three parts.
quote: Today this type of the temple of God is fulfilled in us.

meaning: Represents Satan, the source of death.
quote: This tree represents nothing else than Satan, the source of death.

meaning: Signifies God Himself in Christ as our life.
quote: the tree of life signifies God Himself in Christ as our life.

meaning: Typifies wandering in the soul after salvation, short of entering the spirit.
quote: What does this typify? It means that many Christians after being saved are simply wandering in the soul.

meaning: Signifies humanity, the human nature of the tabernacle boards.
quote: The wood of the boards (Exo. 26:15) signifies humanity, the human nature.
